elaine: noticing a latency regression on Dedicated NVLink clusters since yesterday's runtime push. P50 up ~12% on pp=2 models, tails worse. :eyes:
noah: which change landed? kernel selector tweak? batching heuristic?
elain? (typo) elaine: yes — landed new kernelselect heuristic that favors fused matmul kernels for medium sequence lengths. thought it would reduce compute, but profiling shows all-reduce walltime up on some topologies. link to heatmap: https://dash.internal.redwood/perf/21789-kernelselect-regression
cheng: can you paste the perf sample? guessing increased reqs per step changed batch slicing -> bigger cross-node allreduce unexpectedly.
elaine: small snippets from pprof (nvlink mesh 4xA100):
```
--- trace summary ---
kernel: fused_matmul_v2  42%  (was 18%)
allreduce: nccl_ring      27%  (was 10%)
comm_wait:              18%  (was 5%)
kv-prefetch-misses:     12%  (increase)
```
noah: hmm fused kernel packs more threads but increases tensor fragmentation, causing more frequent small allreduces? mesh routing might split work across pairs -> more sync points.
samir: also seeing KV cache thrash in kv-shard mode when fused kernels change sequence boundaries. Prefetch window assumes stable batch slice sizes. If kernelselect changes per-step memory footprint we might be evicting cache more often.
cheng: this matches topology-sensitive behavior: on NVLink fully-connected pods overhead tolerable; on partial NVLink/PCIe mixes we cross PCIe for some neighbors -> latency spike. Which clusters?
elaine: repro on nvmesh-us-west-2-rack3 and on hybrid-us-east (nvlink+pcie). Not repro on EFA-only clusters (but EFA has different kernel fallback path).
samir: can you share the rolling deploy id? deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T02:13Z by @cheng -> runtime/kernelselect:v3.4.1 (canary 10% -> 100% at 02:40). :information_source:
noah: ok rollback candidate. But before that, quick experiments: 1) force older kernel selector (v3.4.0) on a canary rack and compare perf traces. 2) capture NCCL logs to see increased small allreduce counts.
elaine: ran canary revert on rack3 (manually set kernelselect=stable) — p50 dropped back to baseline within 15m. I uploaded trace diffs here: https://dash.internal.redwood/trace/21789/diff
```
before: avg allreduce_count_per_step=6.8
after:  avg allreduce_count_per_step=2.3
kv_miss_rate before=0.14 -> after=0.03
```
cheng: that's pretty conclusive. Kernel selector variant increases allreduce frequency and KV miss rate. Likely our cost model didn't account for cross-node fragmentation on partial meshes.
samir: root cause hypothesis: kernelselect chooses fused_matmul_v2 because it reduces local compute cycles for single-GPU profile, but when TP/PP slicing yields smaller local tensors, fused kernel causes extra intermediate buffers that break contiguous KV caching and force extra halo exchanges.
noah: what do perf traces show about comm/compute overlap? any lost overlap?
elaine: yes, overlap percent dropped from ~62% to ~39% in the bad runs. That explains latency bump and tail skew.
perf-bot: autotriage: regression detected on 2 clusters, severity=sev3, suggested action=rollback, linked PR=github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4128
samir: propose three-step plan: 1) rollback kernelselect v3.4.1 from Dedicated fleets (immediate rollback). 2) add topology-aware penalty to cost model: penalize kernels that increase non-local buffer count when partial mesh detected. 3) add unit test that simulates shard placement variance + assert kv_miss_rate not > X.
cheng: also add a micro-benchmark that measures allreduce_count_per_step for a synthetic PP/TP mix to catch this in CI.
noah: agree. I'll open quick PR to rollback and schedule follow-up. Can someone own the topology-aware cost tweak?
samir: I'll take it. Will start instrumenting kernelselect to surface "estimated_nonlocal_buffers" metric in logs.
elaine: thanks — I already pinned the rollback canary and notified infra. If people can pluck the NCCL logs from the two failing racks and upload to the perf-ticket that helps. Ticket: https://issues.internal.redwood/INF-9812
noah: grabbing logs now. Also adding a short note to release notes and cherrypick revert commit. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollback job started for runtime/kernelselect:v3.4.1 -> v3.4.0 on nvmesh-us-west-2-rack3 at 02:58Z
elaine: after rollback p50/p95 trending back to baseline, will keep monitoring 2x windows. Thanks team. :heart:
noah: follow-ups: make kernel selection aware of batch-slice variance, KV eviction sim in CI, and update Optimize docs with guidance on shard placement sensitivity.
cheng: filing engineering follow-ups now. closing thread when checks green.
